note: Help text for the radiation alerts, read by the detail view. Kept apart from radiation-engine.js and rules.json, which are not changed. No scoring here.

cumulative_dose.label: Cumulative career dose
cumulative_dose.howToMeasure: The app does not measure this. On real missions, personal dosimeters and the ground team track the running total. Here the dose is simulated.
cumulative_dose.whyItMatters: Radiation dose adds up over a career. NASA requires the career total to stay under 600 mSv.
cumulative_dose.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card and tell the flight surgeon if the total keeps rising.
cumulative_dose.source: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 Rev C (V1 4030) via NASA OCHMO-TB-020

symptom_check_in.label: Radiation symptom check-in
symptom_check_in.howToMeasure: In the daily check-in, tick any of: nausea, vomiting, unusual fatigue, skin redness or irritation, fever or chills, easy bruising or bleeding.
symptom_check_in.whyItMatters: These can be possible signs of radiation exposure but have many other causes, so they are combined with dose and space weather.
symptom_check_in.action: Log every possible symptom and tell the flight surgeon if they continue.

solar_proton_flux.label: Solar proton flux (10 MeV and above)
solar_proton_flux.howToMeasure: Read the flux from space-weather data. NOAA's GOES satellites report protons at 10 MeV and above in pfu. Here the value is simulated.
solar_proton_flux.whyItMatters: A solar particle event is a burst of fast protons from the Sun that can raise exposure within hours. Follow your mission's solar particle event procedure.
solar_proton_flux.action: Follow your mission's solar particle event procedure and the suggested action on the alert card.
solar_proton_flux.source: NOAA SWPC S-scale; points per level are a design value

radiation_overall.label: Overall: radiation
radiation_overall.howToMeasure: Calculated by the app from this module's indicators; you do not measure it.
radiation_overall.whyItMatters: It combines the module's signals into one status so no single reading raises an alert alone. Act means follow the suggested action and contact the flight surgeon.
radiation_overall.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card. For Act, contact the flight surgeon.
